name: free-guide
description: Complete community guide to running ZCode on a free stack: quota-safe fallback chain from the Z.ai plan through free cloud providers to an unlimited local GPU model, plus three companion skills (key setup, automatic model fallback, token/quota tracking). Read docs-guide.md first.

Read docs-guide.md first.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 完整的 ZCode 免费方案社区指南：从 Z.ai 套餐到免费云供应商再到本地 GPU 无限量模型的额度安全回退链，并附带三个配套技能（密钥接入、模型自动回退、用量/额度统计）。请先阅读 docs-guide.md。
